title: A platform of ADAPTive scaffolds: development of CDR-H3 β-hairpin mimics into covalent inhibitors of the PD1/PDL1 immune checkpoint
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00174E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sarah H. Naylon, Alexis D. Richaud, Guangkuan Zhao, Linda Bui, Craig P. Dufresne, Chunjing J. Wu, Medhi Wangpaichitr, Niramol Savaraj, Stéphane P. Roche
This study presents a biomimetic platform technology (ADAPT) that enables the display of antibodies CDR-H3 loops into stand-alone β-hairpin peptide scaffolds to design new classes of sizeable PPI inhibitors.
